english.title: Operator of a service under the RSR Protocol fail to provide information to passengers
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated an international

(A)_[regular]_
(B)_[special regular]_

passenger service, namely **(..DESCRIBE SERVICE..), and, in breach of Article 13(2) of the RSR Protocol, failed to display the route of the service, the bus stops, the timetable, the fares and the conditions of carriage in such a way as to ensure that such information was readily available to all users
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1)(b) and 18 of the Road Transport (International Passenger Services) Regulations 2018.
